title: Multi-Site Credit Programme for Small Business Electricity Supply: Combining Sites and Counting Supplied Sites
content:
## 1. Combination of sites

1.1 Small Business Electricity Supply agreements are combined across all of the business customer's sites for the multi-site credit.

1.2 Each site's credit is computed from its own plan, so sites on different plans receive different amounts, and sites on a plan whose multi-site credit per cycle is 0.00 count toward the minimum but receive nothing. The multi-site credit per cycle of each plan is the figure listed for that plan in the bill credit schedule.

1.3 Sites served under Beacon Ridge commercial and industrial contracts do not count toward the minimum.

1.4 At most one multi-site credit is posted per agreement per billing cycle. Whether a credit is already on the bill is read from the agreement's bill lines: a multi-site credit line on the same agreement for the same billing cycle (the same cycle start date) means the cycle already has its credit.

## 2. Counting supplied sites on a day

2.1 The number of the business's supplied small business sites on a given day (for the multi-site credit, the first day of the cycle being credited) is the count of the business's Small Business Electricity Supply agreements whose service start date is on or before that day and whose status is:

- active; or
- drop pending, with a drop effective date after that day; or
- closed, with a close date after that day.

2.2 Illustration on hypothetical records, counted for a cycle beginning 1 March:

| Agreement | Service start | Status and date | Counted on 1 March |
|---|---|---|---|
| Site 1 | 10 January of the previous year | active | yes |
| Site 2 | 3 February | drop pending, drop effective 15 March | yes |
| Site 3 | 2 May of the previous year | closed, close date 28 February | no |
| Site 4 | 4 March | active | no (supply started after the day) |

Two sites are counted.

## 3. Retired clause

3.1 The following clause is **no longer in force**: "For each billing cycle of an agreement whose plan has a multi-site credit per cycle above 0.00, one multi-site credit of that amount is posted when the customer's count of supplied small business sites on the cycle's first day is at least the plan's multi-site minimum." It has been superseded and is not applied.

superseded_clauses: For each billing cycle of an agreement whose plan has multi_site_credit_usd_per_cycle above 0.00, one multi_site_credit of that amount is posted when the customer's count of supplied small business sites on the cycle's billing_period_start (bizpower_msr_active_sites) is at least multi_site_min_sites.
